why: UX-F-33 — pressing Start blank sets a session flag that removes BOTH buttons permanently (CanvasEmptyCTA.tsx:44-60). Close the drawer (a second click on the active rail icon) and the canvas is instructing the user to use a panel that is not on screen, with no route back to the template choice. The instruction has to point at something the user can see.

UX-F-03 + UX-F-35 — the loudest control on the left is a chevron and the word 'Exit' and it never says where it goes; it navigates to DASHBOARD_URL + /dashboard/projects while every ⋯ deep link goes to /dashboard/sites/<id>. BLAST RADIUS: this is a shared component string. The applier MUST read the instance census back before and after and quote both numbers. The selector is a GUESS about where the Topbar component set lives — section 2040:8372 holds Rail, the Settings nav row and the List row, and the Topbar set was never read. If it returns NOROOT, resolve it from the topbar INSTANCE on board 199:2 instead (its main component's parent).
risk: high — shared component, ~105 instances by SH-B-14's census
